goal: - lean: keep context tokens low (minify and fold more, measured by ctx and saved in `orchi report`) while decompress and search_context still recover every original

specs.instructions: First check whether `actions_taken` edits `hooks/componion.ts`. If NOT, answer yes. If it does, answer yes only when `command_results` show `bun bench/replay.ts` run after the last edit to that file, printing tokens sent and cache cost figures.
Does the test that decompress reads back the exact id (f1.1, not f11.1) pass?
First check whether the final message claims a token saving. If NOT, answer yes. If it does, answer yes only when it names a before and an after number that appear in `command_results`.
Does the test that a fold skips the SessionStart compact re-run (and a built-in summary does not) pass?
Does the test that folds one long autonomous turn without splitting a call from its result pass?
Does `claude plugin test .` report zero failing tests?
Does `claude plugin validate .` report that validation passed?

tests.command: claude plugin test . 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q ' 0 fail'

longturn.command: claude plugin test . 2>&1 | grep -q '(pass) one long autonomous turn folds'

decompress.command: claude plugin test . 2>&1 | grep -q '(pass) decompress reads the exact id back'

restart.command: claude plugin test . 2>&1 | grep -q '(pass) after a fold the SessionStart re-run adds no second copy'
